statement: For the actual F19--F23 inclusions mathcal K_sign <= R_sign <= V_sign, every finite field k and continuous character chi:V_sign->k^* nontrivial on R_sign give injective actual restriction maps on continuous crossed homomorphisms Z^1 and on H^1 with rank-one coefficients k_chi. For every continuous rho:V_sign->Aff_1(k), Fix_k rho(mathcal K_sign)=Fix_k rho(R_sign); a scalar character nontrivial on R_sign makes both equal Fix_k rho(V_sign). For the exact class rho(mathcal K_sign) intersect T_k={1}, the actual marginal images rho(mathcal K_sign) and rho(R_sign) agree. The universal coefficient rank is proved over every field by exact integer Laurent identities. Full marginal equality and K+=D+ remain unresolved.

computational_checks: Nineteen exact negative marginal braid evaluations; eleven old-source action matrices and eight signed collision derivation rows; 64 actual source-conjugated rows. Four field-character charts have rank seven: 389,444,445,196 exact Laurent row operations, with the first chart completed by r48+t1*t2*t3*t4*t5*t7*r5=-e2. The retained longer first-chart scalar certificate has 50 operations. Independent generic-affine-law reconstruction and full certificate replay, importing none of the producers, passes 13982 exact assertions. No finite-field sample or prime integer inversion is used.
notes: The final image-equality hypothesis is exactly rho(mathcal K_sign) intersect the translation subgroup T_k={1}. Its injective scalar image has order invertible in k; the explicit average of m(0) gives a common fixed point. The actual crossed-homomorphism restriction theorem then forces the whole V image to fix that point when chi(R_sign) is nontrivial. F21 normal generation gives the equality through D+->R_sign->rho(R_sign). The nonzero translation-intersection case is retained as an exact remaining obstruction; no ambient invariant quotient or complement is assumed. The positive result uses pullback by the explicit B_plus and its inverse from F23.13. No new bibliography entry is needed.
